name: 21V Cordless Brushless One-Hand Mini Chainsaw & Pruning Saw
shortDescription: Lightweight 21V brushless mini cordless chainsaw with 6-inch guide bar, tool-free chain tensioning, and safety splash baffle for fast one-handed cutting.
overview: Designed for rapid cutting of construction timber, scaffolding planks, tree branches, and wooden pallets, this 21V cordless one-hand mini chainsaw combines the power of a brushless motor with exceptional compact maneuverability. Weighing just 1.2 kg including the lithium-ion battery pack, it allows effortless overhead and single-handed cutting without petrol fumes or cumbersome extension cords. The hardened alloy steel chain travels at 8 meters per second, slicing cleanly through 150mm round wood in under 8 seconds. Dual safety locks, an adjustable 90-degree sawdust baffle, and an integrated handguard provide total operator safety.
keyFeatures: Brushless copper motor delivers 30% higher torque and 2x longer motor lifespan
21V high-capacity Lithium-Ion rechargeable battery with fast-charging intelligence
6-inch (150mm) laser-hardened guide bar cuts branches and lumber up to 150mm thick
High chain speed of 8 m/s provides clean, splinter-free cuts through hardwoods
Featherweight 1.2 kg build allows comfortable single-handed and overhead operation
Tool-free chain tensioning knob for instant on-site chain adjustment
Multi-point safety system: safety lock switch, rotating protective baffle, and hand guard
applications: Construction wood framing, formwork, and pallet breakdown
Tree pruning, orchard trimming, and land clearance
Carpentry cuts in tight roof trusses and scaffolding towers
Emergency clearing of fallen trees and fence repairs
